# Introduction

This document transforms a dataset that is not in the CWP format into the CWP format:
it first changes the structure of the data, then maps its codes to the CWP code lists.
It is generated from the function `gta_rawdata_iattc_catch_ps_shark_byflag()` (`R/rawdata_iattc_catch_ps_shark_byflag.R`), the code that the Global Tuna Atlas workflow runs.

The raw dataset is read from the `data/` folder next to this document, which holds the first
lines of each file under the name given by the tRFMO at export (this name may change).
A summary of the mapping is given at the end; the results are saved in the same folder.

*Knit the document from the repository (here::here() locates its root), or run it chunk by chunk.*

# The function


This function harmonizes the structure of IATTC PS (Purse Seine) shark catch datasets by flag,
preparing them for integration into the Tuna Atlas database. It ensures that only the essential
fields are retained and that metadata is included if the dataset is destined for the database.

@details The function processes the data based on flag categories specifically for shark species.
         It involves cleaning, restructuring, and harmonizing data fields to meet specified
         standards. Metadata integration is optional and contingent on the destination of the dataset.

@seealso \code{FUN_catches_IATTC_CE_Flag_or_SetType_Shark()} for the specific processing of shark catches by flag,
         \code{IATTC_CE_catches_pivotDSD_to_harmonizedDSD()} for general data structuring.
@author Paul Taconet, IRD \email{paul.taconet@ird.fr}

@param data The raw dataset: a data frame, or the path to the file.
@return The harmonized dataset (data frame), as written by the geoflow action
  (iattc/catch/ps_shark_byflag/action_iattc_catch_ps_shark_byflag.R).

```{r}
# Packages the function uses unqualified, attached as in the workflow
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(data.table); library(reshape2); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readxl) })
pkgload::load_all(here::here(), export_all = TRUE, helpers = FALSE, quiet = TRUE)   # gta package of the repository
gta_rawdata_iattc_catch_ps_shark_byflag <- function(data) {
  # Samples of the input and output data (from the former script)
  # '# This script works with any data that has the first 5 columns named and ordered as follow: {Year|Month|Flag|LatC1|LonC1|NumSets}
  path_to_raw_dataset <- gta_path(data)
catches_pivot_IATTC <-FUN_catches_IATTC_CE_Flag_or_SetType_Shark(path_to_raw_dataset,"Flag","PS")
catches_pivot_IATTC$NumSets<-NULL

colToKeep_captures <- c("FishingFleet","Gear","time_start","time_end","AreaName","School","Species","CatchType","CatchUnits","Catch")
catches<-IATTC_CE_catches_pivotDSD_to_harmonizedDSD(catches_pivot_IATTC,colToKeep_captures)

colnames(catches)<-c("fishing_fleet","gear_type","time_start","time_end","geographic_identifier","fishing_mode","species","measurement_type","measurement_unit","measurement_value")
catches$source_authority<-"IATTC"
catches$measurement_type <- "RC" # Retained catches
catches$measurement <- "catch"
catches$measurement_processing_level <- "original_sample" # as collected by observers
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#@eblondel additional formatting for next time support
catches$time_start <- as.Date(catches$time_start)
catches$time_end <- as.Date(catches$time_end)
  catches
}
```

# Harmonisation

```{r}
path_to_raw_dataset <- here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'iattc', 'catch', 'ps_shark_byflag', 'data', 'PublicPSSharkFlag.csv')
georef_dataset <- gta_rawdata_iattc_catch_ps_shark_byflag(path_to_raw_dataset)
write.csv(georef_dataset, here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'iattc', 'catch', 'ps_shark_byflag', 'data', 'PublicPSSharkFlag_harmonized.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Mapping to the CWP code lists

```{r}
fact <- "catch"
mapping_codelist <- map_codelists_no_DB(fact, dataset_to_map = georef_dataset, mapping_keep_src_code = FALSE, summary_mapping = TRUE, source_authority_to_map = c("IATTC", "CCSBT", "WCPFC"))
```

Unmapped values, then the results:

```{r}
georef_dataset <- mapping_codelist$dataset_mapped %>% dplyr::mutate(fishing_fleet = ifelse(fishing_fleet == 'UNK', 'NEI', fishing_fleet), gear_type = ifelse(gear_type == 'UNK', '99.9', gear_type))
# The summaries are NULL when nothing was mapped (e.g. tRFMOs not in source_authority_to_map)
if (!is.null(mapping_codelist$recap_mapping)) data.table::fwrite(mapping_codelist$recap_mapping, here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'iattc', 'catch', 'ps_shark_byflag', 'data', 'PublicPSSharkFlag_recap_mapping.csv'))
if (!is.null(mapping_codelist$not_mapped_total)) data.table::fwrite(mapping_codelist$not_mapped_total, here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'iattc', 'catch', 'ps_shark_byflag', 'data', 'PublicPSSharkFlag_not_mapped_total.csv'))
data.table::fwrite(georef_dataset, here::here('R/tunaatlas_scripts/pre-harmonization', 'iattc', 'catch', 'ps_shark_byflag', 'data', 'PublicPSSharkFlag_CWP_dataset.csv'))
head(mapping_codelist$recap_mapping)
```
